title.zh: 植物品种保护修正命令 2020

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-5-2020-PLANT-VARITIES-PROTECTION-AMENDMENT-ORDER-2020.pdf》（3 页），本次切分 5 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Plant Varieties Protection (Amendment) Order, 2020 and shall be deemed to have commenced on 23rd April 2019.

Section 2 of the Plant Varieties Protection Order, 2015, in this Order referred to as the principal Order, is amended by deleting the definition of "Minister". of section 16 "Minister" and by substituting "Attorney General7' therefor.

Section 46 of the principal Order is amended, in the definition of "authorised officer", in paragraph (b), by deleting "Minister" from the second line and by substituting "Attorney General" therefor. "Minister" from the first line and by substituting "Attorney General" therefor. of section 62

Section 62 of the principal Order is amended by deleting "Minister" from the first line and by substituting "Attorney General" therefor. "Minister" and by substituting "Attorney General" therefor. "Registrar may, with the approval of the Minister," and by substituting "Attorney General may, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan," therefor.

Section 66 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection (I), by deleting "Minister" from the first line and by substituting "Attorney General" therefor. Made this 19th. day of Jamadilakhir, 1441 Hijriah corresponding to the 13th. day of February, 2020 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN, BRUNEI DARUSSALAM.
